# Agent Development Kit (ADK)

> Principal-engineer-grade skills for software development agents. 52 skills, 18 agents, ~42,000 lines of instructions with lazy loading (~200-500 lines per task).

## Overview

ADK is a Claude Code plugin providing structured workflows for code review, documentation, research, codebase audits, diagrams, planning, migrations, refactoring, and MCP-native publishing. Designed for Claude Code; individual skills installable via `npx skills` for Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other SKILL.md-compatible agents.

## Install

Plugin: `/plugin marketplace add sujeet-pro/agents-devkit && /plugin install adk@adk-marketplace`
skills.sh: `npx skills add sujeet-pro/agents-devkit`
Local: `git clone https://github.com/sujeet-pro/agents-devkit.git ~/.devkit && claude --plugin-dir ~/.devkit`

## Skill Categories

- Guideline (17): Reusable knowledge auto-invoked by task skills (workflow, communication, coding, architecture, etc.)
- Task (30): User-facing engineering tasks (code-review-pr, dev-build, docs-write, plan, audit, team, etc.)
- Routing (5): Orchestrators that detect task type and route to sub-skills (use, dev, docs, code-review, diagram)

## Key Skills

- code-review-pr: PR, local, or branch code review with fix/describe/finalize stages
- dev-build: Implement features, debug, enhance, TDD — auto-detects mode
- docs-write: Create/update formal documents (ADR, RFC, blog, changelog)
- plan: Brainstorm, write, execute, track implementation plans
- research: Multi-agent research with citations
- audit: Codebase, security, performance, dependency audit
- diagram-mermaid: Mermaid diagrams (21 types) with full syntax reference
- use: Default orchestrator — expand intent, identify skills, confirm, execute

## Architecture

- 6-phase workflow: Intent → Research → Selection → Planning → Execute → Validate
- 4 workflow families: Quick Action, Standard Task, Complex Build, Investigative Loop
- Complexity-adaptive: trivial (1 file) skips to execute; large (>8 files) uses all phases with PE check
- Self-sufficient: each skill has inline fallbacks if helper skills are missing
- Lazy loading: only ~200-500 lines load per task from ~42,000 total
- Human-in-the-loop: confirm intent, present options, approve plan before executing
- Auto mode: --auto skips confirmations

## Agents (18)

Reusable child-agent definitions for parallel work: code-reviewer, repo-auditor, security-reviewer, pr-fixer, doc-reviewer, doc-writer, research-agent, migration-analyst, frontend-designer, intent-analyst, plan-reviewer, progress-tracker, consensus-agent, source-publisher, guideline-auditor, test-agent, debugger, code-snippet-agent.

## File Structure

- skills/: 52 skill directories, each with SKILL.md, references/, scripts/
- agents/: 18 agent definitions (.md files)
- templates/skill/: Shared templates and propagation scripts
- hooks/hooks.json: Lifecycle hooks (PostToolUse, Stop, SessionStart)
- docs/: Pagesmith documentation site (guide + reference)
- manifest.json: Upstream source tracking
- skills-manifest.json: Programmatic skill discovery index
